idea-plugin.name: Tally - Dockerfile Linter & Formatter
idea-plugin.description:
The Dockerfile linter that understands your stack.

BuildKit-native Dockerfile intelligence for JetBrains IDEs, including PhpStorm, RubyMine, Rider, IntelliJ IDEA, GoLand, PyCharm, and WebStorm.

  • Stack-aware rules for PHP, Ruby, PowerShell, shell, Windows containers, and package ecosystems.
  • Modern Dockerfile guidance for heredocs, cache mounts, multi-stage builds, security, and current BuildKit practices.
  • Safe quick fixes, Fix All on Save, and Dockerfile formatting from the editor.
  • Config-aware behavior with .tally.toml / tally.toml discovery.
  • BuildKit checks and Hadolint-compatible coverage, with no Docker daemon required.
